notice: One reader-facing name and description per registered block type. Canonical block ids, recipe fields and analytical inputs are never derived from these strings.

intro.name: Report context
intro.description: What data, question and scope this report covers.

series-collection.name: Annual trends by disease
series-collection.description: Saved observations across years for one or more diseases, each with its exact recorded values.

series-trend.name: Annual trend for one disease
series-trend.description: Saved observations across years for a single disease. Historical recipes only; not offered as a new section.

reference-comparison.name: Change from the reference year
reference-comparison.description: The saved comparison between the reporting year and the baseline (reference) year.

monitoring-overview.name: Latest observations by disease
monitoring-overview.description: The latest saved observation for each disease within the reporting window.

coverage-selection.name: Coverage and included data
coverage-selection.description: What the saved selection includes and excludes, read from saved selection records.

sensitivity-comparison.name: Comparison across analysis choices
sensitivity-comparison.description: Saved main and sensitivity specifications for the same analysis.

reproduction.name: Reproduction and evidence
reproduction.description: How to check the published files and rerun the render.

data-overview.name: Dataset overview
data-overview.description: Record and field counts and the actual selected coverage of the captured dataset.

values-by-group.name: Values by group
values-by-group.description: Observed values per group, with the group's descriptive summary.

values-over-time.name: Values over time
values-over-time.description: Observed values per selected period; gaps and repeated observations stay visible.

coverage-over-time.name: Observation coverage over time
coverage-over-time.description: Which groups have a recorded observation in each period, with the values deliberately not shown.

data-quality.name: Data quality and completeness
data-quality.description: Missingness, invalid handling, repeated group-period keys and diagnostic limits.
